test-child-process-set-blocking.js: Spawns python3, an interpreter that does not exist in a browser (like git, it is a separate native program, not a shell feature).
test-child-process-net-reuseport.js: SO_REUSEPORT (several processes listening on one port, the kernel balancing connections between them) is not implemented by the virtual network.
test-child-process-dgram-reuseport.js: SO_REUSEPORT for UDP is not implemented by the virtual network.
test-child-process-send-boundsocket.js: Sends a net.BoundSocket (new in Node 26: a bound, not yet listening TCP socket) to a child over IPC; passing a bound-only virtual socket between processes is not implemented.
